topic: Reviewing new data pipeline documentation for Japan
summary_markdown:
The conversation covered several technical topics, including a query about how to calculate dynamic slot duration. A specific SQL file (`v_device_session_agg_base.sql`) and a ClickUp ticket were shared for review by an AI tool.

Later discussions focused on data backfilling methodology (specifically setting the delivery date) and best practices for scheduling jobs, noting that job definitions can be managed via YAML files in a repository.

A major topic was the sharing of documentation for a new pipeline alternative to RandoCouple and Windmill. This system is written in Rust, manages job definitions in YAML, and supports running Docker containers/pods within Kubernetes, as well as launching agents.
decisions: The newly developed data pipeline documentation will be reviewed for suitability for the Japanese team.
action_items: Someone needs to have an AI review the provided ClickUp ticket and SQL file regarding dynamic slot duration.
